name: WaxSealInvite
job: An envelope sealed with wax; opening it slides out a card with the owner's announcement or invitation
visitor_action: click/tap or Enter on the seal to open; click again to close
motion: hover lifts the seal and tugs the flap; click: the seal cracks and its shards fall, the flap bends open in 3D to show the liner, the envelope sinks and the card rises out and swings forward to settle; closing reverses and presses a fresh seal (reduced-motion: instant state swap with a crossfade)

checks.render: pass (polish: seal enlarged to carry the closed still)

art_direction: Midnight post: ink-navy laid-paper envelope with fold thickness and shadows, vermilion poured wax seal with ridged rim, crisp emboss and translucent edge, vermilion lattice liner, cool laid-paper card with grotesk type, dark midnight stage
